description: List bridge commands with args schema, example, and group. Same names as GET /tools and the MCP bridge tools. Pass names (a list of command names) or group (core, feature, insert, pick, sketch, document, joint, paint, measure, fea, sheet, git, export, view, agent) to get only those rows; the arg description lists what each group holds. No args or group: "all" is the whole catalog, about 130 KB compact, so ask for a group. The result also carries total (every command) and groups (row counts per group); unknown names come back in missing. Also lists the MCP-only tools this server registers (pair, guide, list_helpers, register_webhook, unregister_webhook, read_messages, reply_to_user, set_status), in the agent group. They are not bridge commands.

group.description: Only the commands in this group: core (script, run, status, errors, history, undo/redo, feature_tree, list_commands); feature (the open feature edit: open, activate, edit, confirm, cancel, delete, rollback); insert (insert_* feature tools and invoke_helper); pick (pick sessions, selection, and the face/edge/body lists); sketch (sketch, slot, hole-centre, workplane and plane sessions); document (parts and assemblies: create, open, rename, delete, insert_part, placement, dirty); joint (assembly joints); paint (face and part paint); measure (measure sessions); fea (FEA study); sheet (sheet metal); git (vault writes and branches); export (STL / 3MF / STEP export); view (screenshot, camera, visibility, cross section, mode, toasts); agent (operator-visible cues and the in-viewer prompt). "all" is the whole catalog.

names.description: Only these commands, in catalog order. Names that are not commands come back in missing.

name: list_commands
